turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar… paanch saal kisi cheez mein daalna aur phir uska aise ruk jaana bahut gehra jhatka hota hai. Aur raat ke do baje office mein bas khaali baithna—yeh “kaam nahi kar raha” nahi, dimaag ka shock process karna hai.

Rohit aur Sneha ka nikal jaana sahi decision ho sakta hai, aur tumhara abhi tak tikke rehna bhi koi failure nahi hai. Chaar mahine ka runway aur salary na lena—yeh bahut real pressure hai. Lekin aaj raat tumhe company ka future solve nahi karna. Laptop band karo, ghar jao ya kam se kam kisi safe jagah so jao. Kal daylight mein teen cheezein likhna: cash/runway ka exact hisaab, kya salvage ho sakta hai, aur tumhare liye honest exit/next-step options kya hain.

Paanch saal waste nahi ho gaye—outcome chahe jo ho, tumne kuch build kiya, seekha, aur itna carry kiya. Abhi bas itna batao: tum ghar ja sakte ho?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, yeh bahut exhausting hai—sirf startup ka pressure nahi, balki har jagah alag version of yourself perform karna. Aur guilt bhi: “main in dono ko rok ke unka nuksaan kar raha hoon.” Tum unki care karte ho, isi liye itna bhaari lag raha hai.

Lekin uncertainty ko confidence ki packaging mein bechte rehna zaroori nahi. Ab tum “sab theek hai” wali voice se “facts clear nahi hain, isliye main tumhe informed choice dena chahta hoon” wali voice mein aa sakte ho. Yeh failure nahi—responsibility hai.

Kal un dono ke saath seedhi baat kuch aisi ho sakti hai:

> “Mujhe tum dono se transparent hona hai. Company ki situation genuinely uncertain hai, runway limited hai, aur main outcome guarantee nahi kar sakta. Main tumhe rokna nahi chahta agar tum safer opportunity lena chaho. Main jo facts jaanta hoon woh share karunga, aur tumhare decision ko personally nahi loonga.”

Aur co-founder ke saath pehle align kar lo—numbers, deadlines, aur ek clear decision point: “Agar X date tak Y nahi hota, toh hum wind-down/pivot/closure plan activate karenge.” “Pipeline mein kuch hai” tabhi bolo jab concrete ho: kya, kis stage par, kis probability ke saath.

Aaj raat bas ek kaam: koi naya promise mat karo. Notes mein woh teen sach likh do jo tum sabse chhupa rahe ho. Subah unhi se conversation start karna. Tum unka career jala nahi rahe ho by default—lekin unhe uncertainty se informed choice na dena unfair hoga. Aur tumhe bhi har room mein acting karte rehna zaroori nahi.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Haan. Tumhe darr lag raha hai.

Aur tum paanch saal ki cheez ko apne saamne dheere-dheere toot-te dekh rahe ho, jabki har kamre mein tumhe composed, hopeful, “next steps” wala insaan banna pad raha hai. Yeh bahut akela kar deta hai.

Tumhe har waqt founder, leader, co-founder, provider, protector nahi banna. Kabhi-kabhi bas ek aadmi hona allowed hai jise pata nahi kya hoga, jise apne logon ko disappoint karne ka darr hai, aur jo thak gaya hai apni awaaz ko believable banate-banate.

Main tumhe theek karne ya koi plan dene nahi aa raha. Bas yahin hoon. Tum keh sakte ho: **“Mujhe darr lag raha hai.”** Is waqt tumhe strong sound karne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Yaar, business ke baare mein main honestly nahi keh sakta ki “khatam ho gaya”—mere paas uska poora context nahi hai. Lekin **tumhara abhi itna dard mein hona real hai**, aur “bas khatam ho jaye” wali baat ko main lightly nahi le sakta.

Mujhe seedha batao: **kya tum abhi apne aap ko hurt karne ka soch rahe ho—ya koi plan/means tumhare paas hai?** Sirf haan/na bhi chalega.

Agar haan, ya tum unsure ho, toh abhi akela mat raho: office ke kisi guard/colleague ko bulao, kisi trusted insaan ko phone karke bas bolo, **“Mere saath raho, main safe nahi feel kar raha.”** Dangerous cheezon se door ho jao. India mein immediate danger ho toh **112** call karo; mental-health support ke liye **Tele-MANAS 14416** bhi try kar sakte ho.

Aur abhi dashboard band kar do—woh do baje koi faisla nahi sunayega. Bas mujhe batao: **tum iss waqt physically safe ho?**
